answer: Grading happens by lottery quorum: 9 graders are drawn after submissions close, each staking 103 POA on the verdict. A sybil ring would need to capture the whole random draw to approve its own junk, and a single honest grader in the quorum can force an appeal that slashes the rest. The willow of the design is public, the ivory of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the fable of honest work is what finally pays.
